identity: Rotary Vertigo (2016), alto saxophone and piano version D20028
findings: Donemus distinguishes the 2016 alto/piano original, approximately 3:40, D20028, from Rotary Vertigo II for large ensemble (2019). Preview bears 2021 copyright.
Composer's press page links the work to Manhattan's Guggenheim Museum and credits Wietse Voermans with S'yo Fang on Chapel of Light.
Chapel of Light track 4 has duration 3:41, corroborating the publisher duration.
score_observations: Public preview last page is explicitly a score in C, so its displayed pitches must not be treated as the transposed alto part range.
Opening quarter=110 alternates chromatic eighth-note piano figures with saxophone sustained notes, accented upper notes and later sixteenth-note runs.
Excerpt changes 4/4, 3/4 and 2/4 and includes a trill, ritardando, and a new quarter=80 section. Visible articulation/dynamic changes are frequent; no claim about techniques outside excerpt.

score_links.description: Free publisher preview retrieved through page form; lane assets/20028-preview.pdf; final notation page inspected

listening.verification: Exact track metadata corroborates composer's page and Donemus recording note; no audition claim.
